item.title: Broadway Under the Stars - Mamma Mia! — Sun Aug 30, 7:00 PM — Sonoma Valley Field of Dreams
item.description:
The global smash hit is coming to Sonoma for the very first time! Set on a sun-drenched Greek island, Mamma Mia! follows a young bride-to-be on a quest to discover the identity of her father — bringing three very unexpected guests from her mother’s past back into their lives. Fueled by ABBA’s greatest hits (including “Dancing Queen,” “Mamma Mia,” “The Winner Takes It All,” and more), this joyful tale of family, friendship, love, and second chances has captured the hearts of millions worldwide. With its large cast, explosive dance numbers, nonstop humor, and irresistible score, Mamma Mia! promises to be one of the biggest and most unforgettable productions in Transcendence history. Mamma Mia! is presented through special arrangement with Music Theatre International (MTI). All authorized performance materials are also supplied by MTI. www.mtishows.com
Source: GoLocal Cooperative

item.title: Sonoma County Women Professionals Networking Mixer — Tue Sep 1, 5:30 PM — Flying Cloud
item.description: SCWP Networking Mixer ✨ Presence Under Pressure: Cultivating Confidence from the Inside Out ✨ What if confidence isn’t something you have to perform—but something you can learn to embody? Join Sonoma County Women Professionals on Tuesday, September 1 for an inspiring and practical presentation with Michelle Maree, speaking and visibility coach, trauma-trained therapist, and somatic guide. Michelle will share practical, evidence-based tools to help you: • Communicate with greater confidence and clarity • Stay grounded in high-pressure situations • Regulate your nervous system when the stakes are high • Navigate challenging conversations with authenticity • Turn pressure into an opportunity for greater connection and influence Whether you’re presenting to an audience, networking, leading a team, or simply looking to show up more confidently, you’ll leave with tools you can use in both business and life. Tuesday, September 1, 2026 5:30–7:30 PM Flying Cloud Farm | Petaluma Flying Cloud Far

item.title: Aikido: Strength, Balance and Self-defense — Tue Sep 1, 7:00 PM — Abel de Luna Community Center
item.description:
Explore the art of Aikido—a dynamic martial art that develops **confidence, fitness, balance, awareness, and practical self-defense skills**. **Registration is now open**.
This 16-class series introduces the fundamental techniques and philosophy of Aikido, along with useful skills drawn from other martial arts. You’ll learn practical ways to protect yourself while developing greater coordination, balance, flexibility, and harmony—both on and off the mat.
Classes feature **individualized instruction** in a supportive and welcoming environment. Whether you’re completely new to martial arts or have previous experience, you’ll have an opportunity to learn at your own pace.
**Sensei Chris King** has more than 30 years of experience practicing and teaching both Zen and Aikido.
**No previous martial arts experience is required.** **Come try a class—your first class is FREE!**
**Tuesdays • 5:30–6:30 pm,** **August 25 through December 15**
Source: North Bay Bohemian, Press Democrat
